# Trained model artifacts (generated by pipeline)

Run `python unified_pipeline.py` or `python pipeline/refresh.py` to populate:

- `risk_engine/xgb_model.json` — XGBoost classifier
- `risk_engine/calibrated_model.pkl` — isotonic calibration
- `risk_engine/imputer.pkl`, `label_encoders.json`, `feature_meta.json`
- `risk_engine/unit_snapshots.json`, `fleet_lookup.json`, `route_stats.json`

The web app loads lightweight JSON exports from `../data/` (see `pipeline/export_webapp.py`).
